<script>
(function() {
  var fbclid = (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)).get('fbclid');
  if (!fbclid) return;
  var tsMs = Date.now();
  var fbc = 'fb.1.' + tsMs + '.' + fbclid;
  document.cookie = '_fbc=' + encodeURIComponent(fbc) +
    '; domain=.krenke.com.br; path=/; max-age=7776000; SameSite=Lax; Secure';
  try { sessionStorage.setItem('fbc_fallback', fbc); } catch(e) {}
})();
</script>

<script>
if (typeof fbq !== 'undefined') {
  fbq('init', '{{Pixel - Facebook}}', {
    em: {{dlv_lead_email}},
    ph: {{jsp_phone_quote}},
    fn: {{dlv_lead_first_name}},
    ct: {{jsp_city_normalized}},
    st: {{dlv_lead_state}},
    country: 'br'
  });
  fbq('track', 'Lead', {
    content_category: {{dlv_lead_segment}},
    content_name: {{dlv_lead_products}},
    content_type: {{dlv_lead_client_type}},
    value: 0,
    currency: 'BRL'
  }, { eventID: {{dlv_event_id}} });
}
</script>
